methods.name: read
methods.help: Returns the text of the file at `path`. It looks for the file in each folder the extension may read. If no folder has it, the call throws a `RuntimeError`.

methods.name: write
methods.help: Writes `text` to the file at `path`. If the extension may not write there, the call throws a `RuntimeError`.

methods.name: status
methods.help: Sends a `GET` request to `host` over HTTP and returns the status code. If the extension may not connect to `host`, the call throws a `RuntimeError`.
